property_summary: For any caller addr and any newOwner addr2, if the caller is the current owner then calling transferOwnership(newOwner) succeeds and updates C.owner() to newOwner; the mutant inverts the require so a call from the current owner will be rejected (or will not update owner) for some inputs.
change_summary: Invert the require so only non-owners can call guarded functions, changing who can call transferOwnership.
